findingDetails.title: Relocated adapters retain a hard dependency on system-spec-kit
findingDetails.scopeProof: Exact helper-import search found five relocated executable consumers and no neutral alias, vendored copy, or loader fallback.
findingDetails.recommendation: Relocate the generic helper behind a neutral runtime-hook import, or declare system-spec-kit as a mandatory dependency and remove the independent-use claim.
findingDetails.claim: Five relocated adapters cannot be adopted or removed independently of skill content because module loading still requires a helper owned by system-spec-kit.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched every changed runtime-hook adapter for the helper import and checked for a neutral alias, vendored copy, package dependency, or loader fallback.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The repository may always ship system-spec-kit with runtime-hooks, but that assumption contradicts the explicit independent-use property and is not encoded as a package dependency.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if the independent-use claim is removed and the dependency is formally required, or the helper is moved behind a neutral stable import.
